description: Verify that Method-ID highest bit = 1 for events / notifications — verified via Subscribe → Ack → Notification chain (SOME/IP §5.1.4)
approach:
[Objective]
SOME/IP encodes 'this is an event/notification' as Method-ID bit-15 = 1. Event subscription path: Subscribe → SubscribeAck → cyclic Notification. The notification must carry method_id with the MSB set.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService with IPv4 Endpoint option.
2. Tester → DUT: SubscribeEventgroup.
3. DUT → Tester: SubscribeAck (TTL > 0).
4. Observation: DUT → Tester: Notification with method_id bit-15 == 1.

[Pass condition]
Notification observed with the event-MSB.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_phase1_no_offer_with_endpoint — no offer with endpoint
• Fail_phase2_subscribe_nacked — subscribe nacked
• Fail_phase2_no_subscribe_ack — no SubscribeAck
• Fail_phase3_no_notification — no event-MSB notification

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted notification carries event-MSB method_id — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_offer_with_endpoint: No OfferService with IPv4 endpoint within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_no_notification: No notification with event MSB within listen window
